## Highlights

- Option-chain analytics remain correct when source fields share internal helper names, and saved chains can be repriced without stale model columns shadowing fresh results. [#85](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/85), [#86](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/86)
- Ordered and numerically extreme aggregate inputs receive corrected EMA, IV percentile, weighted quantile, outlier, EWMA, Sortino and quantile-spread calculations. [#84](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/84)

## Bug Fixes

- Preserve option-chain source names and types while separating calculated BSM fields. A source `__finance_bsm_all` struct could previously supply its own values as reported model prices and Greeks. [#85](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/85)
- Replace existing option-chain model outputs with current calculations, using case-insensitive name matching and consuming inputs before replacement. Other source columns and the input table remain unchanged. [#86](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/86)
- Keep valid `E`/`e` SQL escape strings intact in verification and profiling, including backslash-escaped quotes and newline-concatenated fragments. [#86](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/86)
- Apply the exponential recurrence to EMA and rank the latest IV against prior observations. Scaled, compensated aggregates correct overflow, underflow, cancellation and ordered-merge errors. Quantile-spread boundary ties receive proportional allocation. [#84](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/84)

## Tooling and Release

- Align source, community-manifest, package and runtime-test metadata at 0.2.22 and add regression coverage for repricing and escaped SQL. [#86](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/86)

## Compatibility

- Native release artifacts target DuckDB v1.5.5. Community-catalog publication is a separate upstream step. [Release workflow](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/blob/v0.2.22/.github/workflows/release.yml)
- Function names and overloads are unchanged. Existing `model_price`, `model_delta`, `model_gamma`, `model_vega`, `model_theta`, `model_rho` and `model_implied_volatility` columns are deliberately replaced in option-chain results. Other source fields are preserved. [#86](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/86)
- EMA, IV percentile, aggregate numerical boundaries and quantile-spread ties intentionally produce corrected results. Remaining experimental models and their limitations are documented in the catalog. [#84](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/84), [experimental catalog](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/blob/v0.2.22/docs/experimental_functions.md)

## Validation

- Rebuilt DuckDB v1.5.5 static, smoke, gold and numerical checks pass locally, including 20 Python tests, 618 numerical reference comparisons and 21 invalid-input checks. Local macOS ARM64 sanitizers were disabled. Baseline and fixed native artifacts demonstrate the helper-column pricing regression. [#85](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/85), [#86](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/86)
- Equivalent aggregate price, Greek and IV outputs were checked in same-process debug query-shape experiments. No performance improvement over the original query is claimed. [#85](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/85), [#86](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/86)
